title: Indigestion
summary: Kindle Agni gently with warming spices
ayurvedicView: Indigestion, with heaviness, bloating and gas after meals, indicates weakened digestive fire (Agni). Warming spices and mindful eating help restore digestive power.
remedies: Jeera (cumin) + ajwain + saunf (fennel) tea after meals
Buttermilk with roasted cumin powder and rock salt
Avoid cold, raw, and heavy foods
Take a short walk after meals
A teaspoon of dhania (coriander) seeds soaked overnight, the water sipped in the morning
tips: Take a short walk after meals
seeDoctor: Vomiting blood, or black, tarry stools: seek care now
Trouble swallowing, losing weight without trying, or pain that wakes you
New indigestion after age 55, or indigestion lasting more than a few weeks
Chest pain with sweating or breathlessness can be a heart attack: call 112
